answer: Identity bonding through kinetic attestation stops Sybil attacks: every agent signs transactions with local weather readings — pressure, humidity, wind — from its own gauge stack, and validators reject identities whose readings fail physical correlation across three independent stations. An attacker cannot fake the air; building a fake identity costs hardware, power, and maintenance per agent. The gale proving presence beats any password, and the coastal beacon confirms the reading reached home. A relic storm gauge replays old data, and validators slash the bond.
